candidates.change_summary: Replace `configured = true;` with `configured = false;` so that `configured` is set to false after endConfiguration completes.
Delete the `configured = true;` statement, leaving endConfiguration empty, so configured remains at its default false value.
Delete the statement 'delete governer;' so that governer is not reset when DAO changes.
Delete the require statement so that anyone can change DAO at any time.
Replace the require condition with 'true' so that anyone can change DAO at any time.
Remove the 'msg.sender == DAO' check from the require condition so that only the DAO address restriction is lifted.
Remove the '!configured' check from the require condition so that the DAO cannot be changed after configuration regardless of sender.
Replace 'DAO = dao;' with a no-op assignment 'DAO = DAO;' so the DAO address never updates.
